title: crm
subHeroTitle: All your contacts, deals, and conversations — in one place.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ gives your sales team a CRM they actually want to use. Build custom pipelines, capture leads from every channel, and let AI extract the key insights from your sales calls.

sections.title: Build a database that fits the way you sell
sections.desc: Set up custom databases for contacts, companies, and deals with the exact fields your team needs. Link records together so a contact connects to the company and the deal — all visible in one place.

gridItems.title: Custom databases
gridItems.desc: Create separate databases for contacts, companies, deals, or any entity your business tracks — built to match how you actually work.

gridItems.title: Custom fields
gridItems.desc: Add the fields that matter to your business — text, numbers, dates, dropdowns, phone numbers, file links, and more.

gridItems.title: Connected records
gridItems.desc: Link a contact to their company and the deal they're part of. The full picture is always one click away.

sections.title: Manage your pipeline the way your team thinks
sections.desc: View your deals as a Kanban board to drag and drop through stages, or as a spreadsheet for bulk editing. Advanced filters let you slice the data exactly the way you need it.

gridItems.title: Kanban pipeline board
gridItems.desc: Drag deals between stages and see exactly where every opportunity sits in your pipeline at a glance.

gridItems.title: Spreadsheet view
gridItems.desc: Edit records in bulk, reorder columns, and save custom views — great for teams that think in rows and columns.

gridItems.title: Filters and sorting
gridItems.desc: Build precise queries to find exactly the records you need — by owner, status, date, deal size, or any custom field.

gridItems.title: Totals and grouping
gridItems.desc: See pipeline totals, average deal sizes, and count summaries at the bottom of any column — without exporting to a spreadsheet.

sections.title: Capture leads from wherever they come in
sections.desc: Whether a lead fills out your website form, sends a WhatsApp message, or comes in from a Meta ad — KeilHQ captures them automatically and puts them straight into your pipeline.

gridItems.title: Website forms
gridItems.desc: Embed a lead capture form on any page. Submissions go straight into your CRM — no manual entry.

gridItems.title: WhatsApp & Meta Ads
gridItems.desc: Connect your WhatsApp Business account and Meta Lead Ads to capture inbound leads the moment they come in.

gridItems.title: Spreadsheet import
gridItems.desc: Upload a CSV or Excel file and KeilHQ maps the columns to your fields automatically. Import hundreds of contacts in seconds.

gridItems.title: Email directly from CRM
gridItems.desc: Connect Gmail or Zoho and send emails to contacts without leaving the CRM. Every email is logged to the record automatically.

sections.title: AI that listens to your sales calls and updates your CRM
sections.desc: Record a sales meeting and KeilHQ extracts the key details — what the prospect's budget is, who the decision-maker is, what they need, and when they want to move. All proposed for your review, never applied automatically.

gridItems.title: Sales call intelligence
gridItems.desc: KeilHQ reads your meeting transcripts and extracts budget, authority, need, and timeline details directly into the prospect's record.

gridItems.title: Duplicate detection
gridItems.desc: KeilHQ spots duplicate contacts automatically and lets you review and merge them side by side — keeping your database clean.

gridItems.title: Full contact record
gridItems.desc: Every contact has a dedicated page with their activity history, notes, linked tasks, files, and every interaction — all in one view.

capabilitiesTitle: A CRM built around how you actually sell.
capabilitiesDesc: Custom pipelines, omnichannel lead capture, AI sales insights, and email outreach — all connected to your workspace.
checklistTitle: Your entire revenue pipeline, under control
checklistDesc: KeilHQ gives your sales team the visibility and automation they need to close deals faster — without the complexity of traditional CRMs.
checklistItems: Build a custom pipeline that matches your actual sales process — with the stages, fields, and views your team needs.
Capture leads automatically from your website, WhatsApp, Meta Ads, or a spreadsheet import — no manual data entry.
Send emails directly from any contact record and have every message logged to their history automatically.
AI reads your sales call transcripts and proposes updates to the CRM record — you review and approve each one.
Detect and merge duplicate contacts before they clutter your database and confuse your team.
See the full picture of any contact — their emails, activity, tasks, notes, and deal history — all on one page.
